scenarios.scenario-1: The ladder is deterministic on every fixture: INIT_PROJECT, FIX_INDEX, FIX_LINT_ERRORS, ADD_VERIFICATION_COVERAGE, TRUST_COMMANDS, VERIFY_MODULE, REFRESH_WARNINGS, NEXT_PHASE, NOTHING_TO_DO are returned in priority order with stable ids.
scenarios.scenario-2: A clean, fully verified project with a pending phase recommends NEXT_PHASE; when every phase is done it recommends NOTHING_TO_DO; both exit 0.
scenarios.scenario-3: Advice never fails the build: even FIX_LINT_ERRORS exits 0; only usage/config errors exit 2, and JSON mode returns the ADR-8 envelope.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text/JSON output is asserted by the tests; library paths emit no runtime log markers.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-next.test.ts (all nine codes, priority ordering, trust/coverage/plan-index branches, exit codes, JSON envelope).
notes.note-2: Text digest lines: NEXT / WHY / RUN / IDS / CODE; json data is { action: { code, summary, why, command?, ids? }, root, findings }.
